verdict.rationale: The sign-in method of a state business-filing portal is a fair axis, so it applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes for the SCC site, the Clerk's Information System and Virginia Tax. None describes the published sign-in path, its MFA method, or whether it relies on biometric, in-person or mailed-PIN verification, so there is no evidence of remotely completable credential MFA.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
